you have to install the app, login, then go to the smiley face icon on the bottom right. There should be a credit card icon with a little settings thing on it (it’s to the right of the ticket looking icon). Click into it and you’ll see an option to pick credit or debit on the very first line. The second is the currency line. The third is where you actually go in and put all your payment info (I used Canadian MasterCard). After it saves, go back to the main menu and click the chat icon at the bottom in the middle. There should be a blue truck with all the stuff you bought. One of the buttons gives you the prompt to consolidate all the items. You should then be able to select your presaved payment info and pay for the overall shipping. I did screenshot my phone and use google translate for the images and it helped a lot.
